'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Fink DS Cloud City: Security Tower (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Fink]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: Security Tower (V) (Dark)|VB8-D-cloudcitysecuritytower-pre.gif|label=Cloud City: Security Tower (V)}}
* '''Username:''' Foxhome
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
